subject: Last call: proposal for a small conversion bonus to close Finexa pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 last call — quick ask for a small conversion bonus to close Finexa

Team —

Quick background: Finexa (pilot) is live and usage is trending well — their technical champion Laura Adams signaled a decision window this week. Current outstanding ask is procurement needing a small commercial concession to sign (they asked for pilot uplift or credit to offset initial months while they finish integrations).

Proposed ask: offer a $5,000 credit applied to their first month (one-time, invoice credit) and extend pilot support SLA for 30 days after sign to smooth onboarding. This is intended as a close incentive only for this EoQ push.

Why: their usage profile shows 120k tokens/month potential and a clear upsell path to Dedicated in H1. Finexa's procurement lead has authority to sign with this level of concession but needs a short approval thread from us.

Requesting: rapid approval from Sales Leadership + Finance (cc'd) so I can push the offer this afternoon. If we want to cap differently, happy to adjust the amount. I've attached a one-page offer draft and the pilot usage CSV.

Attachments: proposed-offer-20260913.pdf (offer text), finexa-pilot-usage-stats-20260912.csv

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 last call — quick ask for a small conversion bonus to close Finexa

Kim —

I support making a targeted concession here. $5k one-time credit sounds reasonable given the upsell profile you outlined. Two asks before go: 1) Ben, make sure this won't create an unfavorable precedent (document as a one-off non-recurring credit); 2) Aditya, finance sign-off on accounting and revenue recognition impact.

If both thumbs up, Kimberly — proceed to put the offer in writing and send to Laura with procurement language and a 7-day expiry. Keep legal out unless procurement requests contract redlines.

-Marissa
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks again for the productive pilot partnership. As discussed, we're prepared to offer a one-time credit of $5,000 applied to your first invoice to help cover integration ramp costs and accelerate initial production capacity.

Key terms:
- Credit amount: $5,000 (one-time, non-recoupable)
- Applies to: first invoice after go-live
- Expiry: this offer expires 7 days from today (2026-09-20)
- Conditions: order must be fully signed and dated before expiry; credit will be listed as a contra line on the first invoice and referenced to DEAL-8473.

Attached: proposed-offer-20260913.pdf (one-page offer) and finexa-pilot-usage-stats-20260912.csv (pilot metrics).
